name: Ranger Shackle-Breaker
body:
Shackle-breakers live to obliterate tyranny in all of its forms. A wrongly convicted individual, an enslaved runaway, or a serf starving at the abuse of his lord can all count on a shackle-breaker’s support.

A shackle-breaker has the following class features.

Undeterred

A shackle-breaker allows no distraction to interfere with the mission to topple tyranny. At 1st level, a shackle-breaker gains a +2 bonus on Will saving throws against mindaffecting effects.

This replaces wild empathy.

Liberation Pool

A shackle-breaker cannot rest while individuals suffer under the yoke of oppression. At 2nd level, a shackle-breaker gains a reserve of magical energy in the form of a liberation pool, which he can use to achieve the goal of freedom for all. This liberation pool refreshes each day, after a restful night’s sleep, and is equal to 1/2 the shackle-breaker’s level + his Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). By expending one or more points, a shackle-breaker can activate any of the following abilities.

This replaces all combat style feats.

Alleviate Malady (Ex and Sp)

By expending 1 point from his liberation pool as a standard action, a shacklebreaker can touch a creature to cure 2d8 points of non-lethal damage. A shackle-breaker can touch a target and expend 2 points to cure the dazzled, shaken, or sickened condition.

At 6th level, a shackle-breaker can spend the specified number of points as a standard action to cast the listed spells as spell-like abilities with a caster level equal to his shackle-breaker level: remove fear (2 points), remove paralysis (2 points), restoration, lesser (2 points), remove curse (5 points).

Beacon of Hope (Su)

By expending 1 point from his liberation pool as an immediate action, a shackle-breaker can grant himself or an ally within 30 feet a morale bonus equal to 1/2 his shackle-breaker level (minimum 1) on a failed skill check, saving throw, or combat maneuver roll. If adding this bonus to the failed roll would meet the DC, the attempt is considered successful instead. A creature cannot benefit from this ability more than once per day.

Fear Not (Ex)

When making a Will save against a fear effect, a shackle-breaker can expend 1 point from his liberation pool as an immediate action to gain a +2 morale bonus on saving throw rolls against fear for 1 minute.

Furthermore, any ally that witnesses the shackle-breaker make a successful save, gains a +2 morale bonus on Will saves against fear as well (until the 1 minute duration expires).

Invigorate the Downtrodden (Sp)

By expending 2 points from his liberation pool as a swift action, a shacklebreaker can grant himself and all allies within 30 feet +2d8 temporary hit points. The number of temporary hit points granted increases by +2d8 at 10th and 18th level. A creature cannot benefit from this ability more than once a day.

Bind Oppressor (Sp)

At 14th level, by expending 5 points from his liberation pool as a standard action, a shackle-breaker can cast leashed shackles as a spell-like ability with a caster level equal to his shackle-breaker level.

Unhindered (Su)

By expending 1 point from his liberation pool as a free action, a shackle-breaker can act as though under the influence of freedom of movement until the start of his next turn. By expending 2 points from his liberation pool as a standard action, a shackle-breaker can touch a creature to grant it the effects of freedom of movement for 1 round.

Weapon Against Oppression (Sp)

By expending 1 point from his liberation pool as a free action, a shacklebreaker can grant a weapon he is wielding the ability to ignore the DR of evil creatures that have DR 5 or lower, as long as the damage reduction is not DR/epic. The shacklebreaker also gains a +2 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls made against evil creatures, and a +1 insight bonus to his AC against attacks made by evil creatures. At 10th level, the amount of damage reduction this ability can bypass increases to 10, the bonus on attack and damage rolls increases to +4, and the AC bonus increases to +2.

At 18th level, the shackle-breaker can add either the bane or the keen special weapon ability to his weapon against oppression. Once activated, this ability remains in effect for a number of rounds equal to the shackle-breaker’s Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). A weapon against oppression only functions in the hands of the shackle-breaker that created it.

Battlemate’s Bond (Ex)

At 7th level, a shackle-breaker grants all allies within 30 feet of himself a +1 competence bonus on Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival skill checks anytime he is in one of his favored terrains.

This replaces woodland stride.
